title: Stream Dedup Duel
tagline: Compare four online dedup strategies for detecting repeated elements in a data stream.

curves.label: Exact Hash Set
curves.code: seen=new Set(); for(i=0;i<n;i++){x=stream[i]; if(seen.has(x)) dupCount++; else seen.add(x);} return dupCount;
curves.name: Exact Hash Set

curves.label: Robin Hood Open Addressing
curves.code: table=new Int32Array(m); state=new Uint8Array(m); for(i=0;i<n;i++){x=stream[i]; idx=hash(x)%m; dist=0; while(state[idx]){ if(table[idx]===x) {dupCount++; break;} if(probeDist[idx]<dist){swap(table[idx],x); swap(probeDist[idx],dist);} idx=(idx+1)%m; dist++; } else {table[idx]=x; state[idx]=1; probeDist[idx]=dist;} }
curves.name: Robin Hood Open Addressing

curves.label: Bloom Filter (m bits)
curves.code: bf=new Uint8Array(m); for(i=0;i<n;i++){x=stream[i]; possiblyDup=true; for(k=0;k<K;k++){idx=(h1(x)+k*h2(x))%m; if(!bf[idx]){possiblyDup=false; break;}} if(possiblyDup) dupCount++; for(k=0;k<K;k++){idx=(h1(x)+k*h2(x))%m; bf[idx]=1;} }
curves.name: Bloom Filter (m bits)

curves.label: Count-Min Sketch
curves.code: cms=new Uint32Array(d*w); for(i=0;i<n;i++){x=stream[i]; est=Infinity; for(r=0;r<d;r++){idx=r*w + (hash_r(x,r)%w); cms[idx]++; est=Math.min(est,cms[idx]);} if(est>threshold) dupCount++; }
curves.name: Count-Min Sketch

curves.label: Quadratic Pairwise Check
curves.code: dupCount=0; for(i=0;i<n;i++){for(j=0;j<i;j++){ if(stream[i]===stream[j]){dupCount++; break;} } } return dupCount;
curves.name: Quadratic Pairwise Check
